counting_note: source_records counts catalog rows including explicit derived_records; original_file_records counts included source-file records; source_bytes excludes derived duplication.
boundaries: Source files were read only and were not rewritten.
Rules, scripts, HTML and SVG are inert reference data, not installed capabilities.
Binary image and PDF attachments were not individually visually redacted.
SQLite ordinary tables were converted to sanitized JSONL; source SQL was not executed.
Source paths are provenance records, not dependencies on the maintainer computer.
Content availability does not imply current platform compatibility or customer acceptance.
HTML remains inert source text; readable text/tables are derived on demand without another stored body.

navigation.boundary: Catalog links reference inert objects; source-relative links require runtime catalog resolution. No duplicate reading pages or link audit logs are shipped.
